```{r}
#Pull data:
clean_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    stringr::str_trim() %>%
    dplyr::na_if("") %>%
    stringr::str_to_lower() %>%             # standardize case
    stringr::str_replace_all("\\s+", " ")   # collapse weird spacing
}

pretty_title <- function(x) {
  # Optional: for plotting labels (title case)
  stringr::str_to_title(x)
}

#NCSS data:

    #pedon, taxonomic name and series name: 
    ncss_pedon <- read.csv("../data/Pedon_SCP_MLRA.csv") #siteobsiiref is pedon id
    
    #horizon name, seq, top depth, bottom depth, some texture:
    ncss_phorizon <- fread("../data/ncss_phorizon.csv") #peiidref is pedon id (multiples per pedon)

    #color per horizon, hue value, chroma:
    ncss_color <- read.csv("../data/ncss_phcolor.csv") #phiidref is pedon id
    
    #mottles present per hz, HVC and percentage:
    ncss_mottles <- read.csv("../data/ncss_phmottles.csv") #phiidref is pedon id
    
    #lab data: CEC
    ncss_labdata  <- fread("../data/ncss_labdata.csv") #ncsslabdataiidref is pedon id , seq is hz 
    
    #ped_taxa:
    ncss_ped_taxa <- read.csv("../data/petaxhistory.csv")
    
    #ncss pedon lab data:
    ncss_pedonlabdata <- read.csv("../data/ncss_pedonlabdata.csv") 
   # str(ncss_pedon)
   #  str(ncss_phorizon)

    # =========================
# FILTER: Coastal Plain only
# =========================
# Adjust these patterns to match your pedon dataset’s region labels.
# Common fields: mlra, mlraoffice, soilphysreg, geomregion, state, etc.
# Start with MLRA name/office + state as a practical filter.
# ============================
# FAST FILTER: keep only Coastal Plain pedons BEFORE joins
# Put this right after reading the CSVs
# ============================

# Coastal Plain pedon IDs (peiidref) + site obs ids
cp_peiidref <- unique(ncss_pedon$peiid)
cp_siteobsi <- unique(ncss_pedon$siteobsiidref)

# 1) Field horizons (keyed by peiidref)
ncss_phorizon <- ncss_phorizon %>%
  filter(peiidref %in% cp_peiidref)

# 2) Pedon lab summary (keyed by peiidref already)
ncss_pedonlabdata <- ncss_pedonlabdata %>%
  filter(peiidref %in% cp_peiidref)

# 3) Lab horizons (keyed by labsampnum; filter by pedlabsampnum from pedon table)
cp_labsamp <- unique(ncss_pedon$pedlabsampnum)
cp_labsamp <- cp_labsamp[!is.na(cp_labsamp) & cp_labsamp != ""]

ncss_labdata <- ncss_labdata %>%
  filter(labsampnum %in% cp_labsamp)

# 4) Tax history (usually keyed by peiidref; if yours uses peiid instead, adjust here)
if ("peiidref" %in% names(ncss_ped_taxa)) {
  ncss_ped_taxa <- ncss_ped_taxa %>% filter(peiidref %in% cp_peiidref)
} else if ("peiid" %in% names(ncss_ped_taxa)) {
  ncss_ped_taxa <- ncss_ped_taxa %>% filter(peiid %in% cp_peiidref)
}

# 5) Optional: Color + mottles are keyed by phiidref (horizon id), so filter using horizon ids
hz_id_col <- intersect(names(ncss_phorizon), c("phiid", "phiidref"))[1]

if (!is.na(hz_id_col)) {
  cp_phiid <- unique(ncss_phorizon[[hz_id_col]])
  cp_phiid <- cp_phiid[!is.na(cp_phiid)]

  ncss_color <- ncss_color %>% filter(phiidref %in% cp_phiid)
  ncss_mottles <- ncss_mottles %>% filter(phiidref %in% cp_phiid)
} else {
  message("No phiid/phiidref column in ncss_phorizon, so can't pre-filter color/mottles by horizon id.")
}
```

```{r}

# ---- Pedon keys (keep only what we need) ----
ped_key <- ncss_pedon %>%
  transmute(
    peiidref = peiid,
    upedonid,
    series_raw   = taxonname,
    series_clean = clean_name(taxonname),
    pedlabsampnum
  )

# ---- Field horizons (profile horizon table) ----
hz_field <- ncss_phorizon %>%
  transmute(
    peiidref,
    seqnum,
    hzdept,
    hzdepb,
    hzname,
    texture = na_if(str_squish(texture), "")
  )

# ---- Lab horizons (tie to pedon using labsampnum) ----
hz_lab <- ncss_labdata %>%
  transmute(
    pedlabsampnum = labsampnum,
    seqnum = layerseqnum,
    hzdept_lab = hzdept,
    hzdepb_lab = hzdepb,
    hzname_lab = hzname,
    sand = sandtotmeasured,
    silt = silttotmeasured,
    clay = claytotmeasured,
    cec7 = cec7,
    ecec = ecec
  ) %>%
  left_join(ped_key %>% select(peiidref, pedlabsampnum), by = "pedlabsampnum") %>%
  select(-pedlabsampnum)

# ---- Merge pedon + horizons + lab ----
hz_master <- hz_field %>%
  left_join(ped_key, by = "peiidref") %>%
  full_join(hz_lab, by = c("peiidref", "seqnum")) %>%
  mutate(
    hzdept = coalesce(hzdept, hzdept_lab),
    hzdepb = coalesce(hzdepb, hzdepb_lab),
    hzname = coalesce(hzname, hzname_lab)
  ) %>%
  select(-hzdept_lab, -hzdepb_lab, -hzname_lab)

# quick sanity
dplyr::glimpse(hz_master)
```

```{r}
# Helper: pick a join column if present
hz_id_col <- intersect(names(ncss_phorizon), c("phiid", "phiidref", "phiid_iidref", "phiidrefref"))[1]

if (!is.na(hz_id_col)) {

  hz_ids <- ncss_phorizon %>%
    transmute(
      peiidref, seqnum,
      phiidref = .data[[hz_id_col]]
    )

  # color (take dominant / first record per horizon)
  hz_color <- ncss_color %>%
    transmute(
      phiidref,
      color_hue = na_if(str_squish(colorhue), ""),
      color_value = colorvalue,
      color_chroma = colorchroma
    ) %>%
    group_by(phiidref) %>%
    summarise(
      color_hue = first(na.omit(color_hue)),
      color_value = suppressWarnings(median(color_value, na.rm = TRUE)),
      color_chroma = suppressWarnings(median(color_chroma, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # mottles (summarise per horizon)
  hz_mott <- ncss_mottles %>%
    transmute(
      phiidref,
      mottle_pct = mottlepct
    ) %>%
    group_by(phiidref) %>%
    summarise(
      mottle_pct = suppressWarnings(max(mottle_pct, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  hz_master <- hz_master %>%
    left_join(hz_ids, by = c("peiidref", "seqnum")) %>%
    left_join(hz_color, by = "phiidref") %>%
    left_join(hz_mott, by = "phiidref") %>%
    select(-phiidref)

} else {
  message("No horizon-ID column found in ncss_phorizon (phiid/phiidref). Skipping color/mottle joins.")
}
```

```{r}
# Clean taxonomy history and pick "best" record per peiidref
tax_best <- ncss_ped_taxa %>%
  mutate(
    peiidref = as.integer(peiidref),
    taxorder    = clean_name(taxorder),
    taxsuborder = clean_name(taxsuborder),
    taxgrtgroup = clean_name(taxgrtgroup),
    taxsubgrp   = clean_name(taxsubgrp),
    taxpartsize = clean_name(taxpartsize),
    taxclname   = clean_name(taxclname),
    recwlupdated_dt = suppressWarnings(as.POSIXct(recwlupdated, format = "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(peiidref) %>%
  arrange(desc(recwlupdated_dt)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(peiidref, taxclname, taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), "unknown", .x)))
```

```{r}
encode_hz_by_depth <- function(hz_df, cut_cm = 150, slice_cm = 15) {

  # Ensure needed cols exist:
  stopifnot(all(c("peiidref", "hzdept", "hzdepb", "hzname") %in% names(hz_df)))

  # 1) Clip horizons to 0–cut_cm and drop anything outside
  hz_clip <- hz_df %>%
    filter(is.finite(hzdept), is.finite(hzdepb), hzdepb > hzdept) %>%
    mutate(
      top = pmax(hzdept, 0),
      bot = pmin(hzdepb, cut_cm)
    ) %>%
    filter(bot > top)

  # 2) Define depth slices: [0, slice_cm), [slice_cm, 2*slice_cm), ...
  slice_edges <- seq(0, cut_cm, by = slice_cm)
  slices <- tibble(
    slice_top = slice_edges[-length(slice_edges)],
    slice_bot = slice_edges[-1]
  ) %>%
    mutate(slice_id = paste0(slice_top, "_", slice_bot))

  # 3) Horizon “type” to encode (master horizons, but keeps Bt separately)
  hz_clip <- hz_clip %>%
    mutate(
      hz_type = case_when(
        str_detect(hzname, "^Ap") ~ "Ap",
        str_detect(hzname, "^[Aa]") ~ "A",
        str_detect(hzname, "^[Ee]") ~ "E",
        str_detect(hzname, "Bt|bt") ~ "Bt",
        str_detect(hzname, "Bg|bg") ~ "Bg",
        str_detect(hzname, "^[Bb]") ~ "B",
        str_detect(hzname, "^[Cc]") ~ "C",
        str_detect(hzname, "^[Rr]") ~ "R",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    )

  # 4) Compute overlap of each horizon with each slice (pedon-wise cross join)
  ov <- hz_clip %>%
    inner_join(slices, by = character()) %>%  # cross join (careful but manageable after filtering)
    mutate(
      overlap = pmax(0, pmin(bot, slice_bot) - pmax(top, slice_top))
    ) %>%
    filter(overlap > 0)

  # 5) Convert overlaps -> proportion of slice (so each slice sums to 1 across hz_type)
  slice_prop <- ov %>%
    group_by(peiidref, slice_id, hz_type) %>%
    summarise(overlap = sum(overlap), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(peiidref, slice_id) %>%
    mutate(slice_total = sum(overlap),
           prop = overlap / slice_total) %>%
    ungroup()

  # 6) One-hot in wide form: columns like "hz_Bt_0_15", "hz_A_30_45", ...
  slice_wide <- slice_prop %>%
    transmute(
      peiidref,
      feature = paste0("hz_", hz_type, "_", slice_id),
      value = prop
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = feature, values_from = value, values_fill = 0)

  return(slice_wide)
}

hz_depth_features <- encode_hz_by_depth(
  hz_master,
  cut_cm = 150,
  slice_cm = 15
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================
# PEDON-LEVEL FEATURE TABLE (0–150 cm only)
# taxonomy + morph + lab summaries + depth-hot-encoding
# ============================================

cut_cm <- 150

# 0) Clip hz_master to 0–150 and make thickness weights
hz_0_150 <- hz_master %>%
  filter(is.finite(hzdept), is.finite(hzdepb), hzdepb > hzdept) %>%
  mutate(
    top = pmax(hzdept, 0),
    bot = pmin(hzdepb, cut_cm),
    thk = pmax(0, bot - top)
  ) %>%
  filter(thk > 0)

mode_chr <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  tt <- sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE)
  names(tt)[1]
}

# 1) Pedon-level summaries from morph/lab/color (weighted to 0–150)
pedon_summary <- hz_0_150 %>%
  group_by(peiidref, upedonid, series_clean) %>%
  summarise(
    max_depth = max(bot, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_thickness = sum(thk, na.rm = TRUE),

    # lab texture + chemistry
    mean_sand = weighted.mean(sand, w = thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_silt = weighted.mean(silt, w = thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_clay = weighted.mean(clay, w = thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_cec7 = weighted.mean(cec7, w = thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ecec = weighted.mean(ecec, w = thk, na.rm = TRUE),

    # color/mottle (if present)
    mean_value  = weighted.mean(color_value,  w = thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_chroma = weighted.mean(color_chroma, w = thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    dom_hue     = mode_chr(color_hue),
    mean_mottle_pct = weighted.mean(mottle_pct, w = thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    any_mottles = as.integer(any(!is.na(mottle_pct))),

    # morphology flags (within 0–150)
    has_A = as.integer(any(str_detect(hzname, "^[Aa]"))),
    has_E = as.integer(any(str_detect(hzname, "^[Ee]"))),
    has_B = as.integer(any(str_detect(hzname, "^[Bb]"))),
    has_C = as.integer(any(str_detect(hzname, "^[Cc]"))),
    Bt_present = as.integer(any(str_detect(hzname, "Bt|bt"))),

    dom_texture = mode_chr(texture),

    .groups = "drop"
  )
pedon_summary <- pedon_summary %>%
  mutate(series = pretty_title(series_clean))
pedon_summary <- pedon_summary %>% mutate(peiidref = as.integer(peiidref))
tax_best      <- tax_best      %>% mutate(peiidref = as.integer(peiidref))
hz_depth_features <- hz_depth_features %>% mutate(peiidref = as.integer(peiidref))

# 2) Merge taxonomy (tax_best) onto pedon summaries
pedon_features <- pedon_summary %>%
  left_join(tax_best, by = "peiidref") %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(taxclname, taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize),
    ~ ifelse(is.na(.x) | .x == "", "Unknown", .x)
  ))
# Make sure join keys are identical types
pedon_summary <- pedon_summary %>%
  mutate(peiidref = as.integer(peiidref))

hz_depth_features <- hz_depth_features %>%
  mutate(peiidref = as.integer(peiidref))

# 3) Merge depth-hot-encoded horizon structure (0–150 slices)
pedon_features <- pedon_features %>%
  left_join(hz_depth_features, by = "peiidref")
hz_cols <- grep("^hz_", names(pedon_features), value = TRUE)
length(hz_cols)


# 4) Build UMAP input matrix: numeric + one-hot categorical + the hz_* slice features
hz_cols <- grep("^hz_", names(pedon_features), value = TRUE)

num_vars <- pedon_features %>%
  select(
    max_depth, total_thickness,
    mean_sand, mean_silt, mean_clay, mean_cec7, mean_ecec,
    mean_value, mean_chroma, mean_mottle_pct, any_mottles,
    has_A, has_E, has_B, has_C, Bt_present,
    all_of(hz_cols)         # <-- depth-hot-encoded horizons
  )

# median-impute numeric NAs (UMAP needs no NA)
num_vars_clean <- num_vars %>%
  mutate(across(everything(),
                ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .x)))

cat_vars <- pedon_features %>%
  select(
    dom_texture, dom_hue,
    taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.x) | .x == "", "Unknown", .x)))

cat_mm <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = cat_vars)

umap_input <- cbind(num_vars_clean, cat_mm)

# Drop zero-variance columns to avoid NaN scaling
good_cols <- apply(umap_input, 2, function(x) is.finite(sd(x)) && sd(x) > 0)
umap_input2 <- umap_input[, good_cols, drop = FALSE]

umap_scaled <- scale(umap_input2)
stopifnot(all(is.finite(umap_scaled)))

# 5) Run UMAP
set.seed(42)
umap_out <- umap(
  umap_scaled,
  n_neighbors = 15,
  min_dist = 0.1,
  metric = "euclidean"
)

beepr::beep("wilhelm")

umap_coords <- as.data.frame(umap_out$layout)
names(umap_coords) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")

umap_df <- bind_cols(
  pedon_features %>%
    select(peiidref, upedonid, series,
           taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize,
           mean_sand, mean_clay, mean_cec7),
  umap_coords
)
umap_df <- bind_cols(
  pedon_features %>%
    transmute(
      peiidref, upedonid,
      series = pretty_title(series_clean),
      taxorder = pretty_title(taxorder),
      taxsubgrp = pretty_title(taxsubgrp),
      mean_sand, mean_clay, mean_cec7
    ),
  umap_coords
)

ggplot(umap_df, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = series )) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2.0) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "UMAP of Coastal Plain NCSS Pedons (0–150 cm features)",
       color = "Order")

```

```{r}
    as.character() %>%
    stringr::str_trim() %>%
    dplyr::na_if("") %>%
    stringr::str_to_lower() %>%
```

``` {r}

# =========================
# Pull data
# =========================
ncss_pedon <- read.csv("../data/Pedon_SCP_MLRA.csv")

ncss_phorizon <- fread("../data/ncss_phorizon.csv")
ncss_color    <- read.csv("../data/ncss_phcolor.csv")
ncss_mottles  <- read.csv("../data/ncss_phmottles.csv")

ncss_labdata  <- fread("../data/ncss_labdata.csv")
ncss_ped_taxa <- read.csv("../data/petaxhistory.csv")

ncss_pedonlabdata <- read.csv("../data/ncss_pedonlabdata.csv")
# ============================
# FAST FILTER: keep only Coastal Plain pedons BEFORE joins
# (you said ncss_pedon is already coastal plain; this just ensures the big tables match)
# ============================
cp_peiidref <- unique(ncss_pedon$peiid)

# horizons
ncss_phorizon <- ncss_phorizon %>%
  filter(peiidref %in% cp_peiidref)

# pedon lab summary
ncss_pedonlabdata <- ncss_pedonlabdata %>%
  filter(peiidref %in% cp_peiidref)

# lab horizons: filter by labsampnum present in the coastal plain pedons
cp_labsamp <- unique(ncss_pedon$pedlabsampnum)
cp_labsamp <- cp_labsamp[!is.na(cp_labsamp) & cp_labsamp != ""]

ncss_labdata <- ncss_labdata %>%
  filter(labsampnum %in% cp_labsamp)

# tax history
if ("peiidref" %in% names(ncss_ped_taxa)) {
  ncss_ped_taxa <- ncss_ped_taxa %>% filter(peiidref %in% cp_peiidref)
} else if ("peiid" %in% names(ncss_ped_taxa)) {
  ncss_ped_taxa <- ncss_ped_taxa %>% filter(peiid %in% cp_peiidref)
}

# optional: filter color/mottles by horizon id if available in horizon table
hz_id_col <- intersect(names(ncss_phorizon), c("phiid", "phiidref"))[1]
if (!is.na(hz_id_col)) {
  cp_phiid <- unique(ncss_phorizon[[hz_id_col]])
  cp_phiid <- cp_phiid[!is.na(cp_phiid)]
  ncss_color   <- ncss_color %>% filter(phiidref %in% cp_phiid)
  ncss_mottles <- ncss_mottles %>% filter(phiidref %in% cp_phiid)
} else {
  message("No phiid/phiidref column in ncss_phorizon; skipping pre-filter for color/mottles.")
}
```

```{r}

# =========================
# Build horizon master: pedon + field horizons + lab horizons
# =========================

# pedon key (clean series here!)
ped_key <- ncss_pedon %>%
  transmute(
    peiidref = as.integer(peiid),
    upedonid,
    series_raw   = taxonname,
    series_clean = clean_name(taxonname),
    pedlabsampnum
  )

# field horizons
hz_field <- ncss_phorizon %>%
  transmute(
    peiidref = as.integer(peiidref),
    seqnum,
    hzdept,
    hzdepb,
    hzname,
    texture = na_if(str_squish(texture), "")
  )

# lab horizons (link labsampnum -> peiidref using ped_key)
hz_lab <- ncss_labdata %>%
  transmute(
    pedlabsampnum = labsampnum,
    seqnum = layerseqnum,
    hzdept_lab = hzdept,
    hzdepb_lab = hzdepb,
    hzname_lab = hzname,
    sand = sandtotmeasured,
    silt = silttotmeasured,
    clay = claytotmeasured,
    cec7 = cec7,
    ecec = ecec
  ) %>%
  left_join(ped_key %>% select(peiidref, pedlabsampnum), by = "pedlabsampnum") %>%
  select(-pedlabsampnum)

# merge all
hz_master <- hz_field %>%
  left_join(ped_key, by = "peiidref") %>%
  full_join(hz_lab, by = c("peiidref", "seqnum")) %>%
  mutate(
    hzdept = coalesce(hzdept, hzdept_lab),
    hzdepb = coalesce(hzdepb, hzdepb_lab),
    hzname = coalesce(hzname, hzname_lab)
  ) %>%
  select(-hzdept_lab, -hzdepb_lab, -hzname_lab)

glimpse(hz_master)
```

```{r}
# =========================
# Add color + mottles if horizon id exists
# =========================
hz_id_col <- intersect(names(ncss_phorizon), c("phiid", "phiidref", "phiid_iidref", "phiidrefref"))[1]

if (!is.na(hz_id_col)) {

  hz_ids <- ncss_phorizon %>%
    transmute(
      peiidref = as.integer(peiidref), seqnum,
      phiidref = .data[[hz_id_col]]
    )

  hz_color <- ncss_color %>%
    transmute(
      phiidref,
      color_hue = na_if(str_squish(colorhue), ""),
      color_value = colorvalue,
      color_chroma = colorchroma
    ) %>%
    group_by(phiidref) %>%
    summarise(
      color_hue = first(na.omit(color_hue)),
      color_value = suppressWarnings(median(color_value, na.rm = TRUE)),
      color_chroma = suppressWarnings(median(color_chroma, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  hz_mott <- ncss_mottles %>%
    transmute(phiidref, mottle_pct = mottlepct) %>%
    group_by(phiidref) %>%
    summarise(
      mottle_pct = suppressWarnings(max(mottle_pct, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  hz_master <- hz_master %>%
    left_join(hz_ids, by = c("peiidref", "seqnum")) %>%
    left_join(hz_color, by = "phiidref") %>%
    left_join(hz_mott,  by = "phiidref") %>%
    select(-phiidref)

} else {
  message("No horizon-ID column in ncss_phorizon; skipping color/mottle joins.")
}
```

```{r}
# =========================
# Taxonomy: pick best (most recent) per pedon and CLEAN it
# =========================
tax_best <- ncss_ped_taxa %>%
  mutate(
    peiidref = as.integer(peiidref),
    taxorder    = clean_name(taxorder),
    taxsuborder = clean_name(taxsuborder),
    taxgrtgroup = clean_name(taxgrtgroup),
    taxsubgrp   = clean_name(taxsubgrp),
    taxpartsize = clean_name(taxpartsize),
    taxclname   = clean_name(taxclname),
    recwlupdated_dt = suppressWarnings(as.POSIXct(recwlupdated, format = "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(peiidref) %>%
  arrange(desc(recwlupdated_dt)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(peiidref, taxclname, taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), "unknown", .x)))
```

```{r}
# =========================
# Depth-hot-encoding of horizons to 150 cm
# =========================
encode_hz_by_depth <- function(hz_df, cut_cm = 150, slice_cm = 15) {

  stopifnot(all(c("peiidref", "hzdept", "hzdepb", "hzname") %in% names(hz_df)))

  hz_clip <- hz_df %>%
    filter(is.finite(hzdept), is.finite(hzdepb), hzdepb > hzdept) %>%
    mutate(
      top = pmax(hzdept, 0),
      bot = pmin(hzdepb, cut_cm)
    ) %>%
    filter(bot > top) %>%
    mutate(peiidref = as.integer(peiidref))

  slice_edges <- seq(0, cut_cm, by = slice_cm)
  slices <- tibble(
    slice_top = slice_edges[-length(slice_edges)],
    slice_bot = slice_edges[-1],
    slice_id  = paste0(slice_edges[-length(slice_edges)], "_", slice_edges[-1])
  )

  hz_clip <- hz_clip %>%
    mutate(
      hz_type = case_when(
        str_detect(hzname, "^Ap") ~ "Ap",
        str_detect(hzname, "^[Aa]") ~ "A",
        str_detect(hzname, "^[Ee]") ~ "E",
        str_detect(hzname, "Bt|bt") ~ "Bt",
        str_detect(hzname, "Bg|bg") ~ "Bg",
        str_detect(hzname, "^[Bb]") ~ "B",
        str_detect(hzname, "^[Cc]") ~ "C",
        str_detect(hzname, "^[Rr]") ~ "R",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    )

  ov <- hz_clip %>%
    inner_join(slices, by = character()) %>%  # cross join
    mutate(overlap = pmax(0, pmin(bot, slice_bot) - pmax(top, slice_top))) %>%
    filter(overlap > 0)

  slice_prop <- ov %>%
    group_by(peiidref, slice_id, hz_type) %>%
    summarise(overlap = sum(overlap), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(peiidref, slice_id) %>%
    mutate(prop = overlap / sum(overlap)) %>%
    ungroup()

  slice_wide <- slice_prop %>%
    transmute(peiidref,
              feature = paste0("hz_", hz_type, "_", slice_id),
              value = prop) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = feature, values_from = value, values_fill = 0)

  slice_wide
}

hz_depth_features <- encode_hz_by_depth(hz_master, cut_cm = 150, slice_cm = 15)

# sanity: should be > 0
sum(grepl("^hz_", names(hz_depth_features)))

```
```{r}
# =========================
# Pedon-level features (0–150 cm summaries) + merge taxonomy + merge hot encoding
# =========================
cut_cm <- 150

hz_0_150 <- hz_master %>%
  filter(is.finite(hzdept), is.finite(hzdepb), hzdepb > hzdept) %>%
  mutate(
    peiidref = as.integer(peiidref),
    top = pmax(hzdept, 0),
    bot = pmin(hzdepb, cut_cm),
    thk = pmax(0, bot - top)
  ) %>%
  filter(thk > 0)

pedon_summary <- hz_0_150 %>%
  group_by(peiidref, upedonid, series_clean) %>%
  summarise(
    max_depth = max(bot, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_thickness = sum(thk, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_sand = weighted.mean(sand, w = thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_silt = weighted.mean(silt, w = thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_clay = weighted.mean(clay, w = thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_cec7 = weighted.mean(cec7, w = thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ecec = weighted.mean(ecec, w = thk, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_value  = weighted.mean(color_value,  w = thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_chroma = weighted.mean(color_chroma, w = thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    dom_hue     = mode_chr(color_hue),
    mean_mottle_pct = weighted.mean(mottle_pct, w = thk, na.rm = TRUE),
    any_mottles = as.integer(any(!is.na(mottle_pct))),

    has_A = as.integer(any(str_detect(hzname, "^[Aa]"))),
    has_E = as.integer(any(str_detect(hzname, "^[Ee]"))),
    has_B = as.integer(any(str_detect(hzname, "^[Bb]"))),
    has_C = as.integer(any(str_detect(hzname, "^[Cc]"))),
    Bt_present = as.integer(any(str_detect(hzname, "Bt|bt"))),

    dom_texture = mode_chr(texture),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    series = pretty_title(series_clean),
    dom_hue = clean_name(dom_hue),
    dom_texture = clean_name(dom_texture)
  )

pedon_features <- pedon_summary %>%
  left_join(tax_best, by = "peiidref") %>%
  left_join(hz_depth_features %>% mutate(peiidref = as.integer(peiidref)), by = "peiidref") %>%
  mutate(across(c(taxclname, taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize),
                ~ ifelse(is.na(.x) | .x == "", "unknown", .x)))

# sanity: hz_ columns exist
hz_cols <- grep("^hz_", names(pedon_features), value = TRUE)
length(hz_cols)
```
```{r}
# =========================
# UMAP
# =========================
hz_cols <- grep("^hz_", names(pedon_features), value = TRUE)

num_vars <- pedon_features %>%
  select(
    max_depth, total_thickness,
    mean_sand, mean_silt, mean_clay, mean_cec7, mean_ecec,
    mean_value, mean_chroma, mean_mottle_pct, any_mottles,
    has_A, has_E, has_B, has_C, Bt_present,
    all_of(hz_cols)
  )

num_vars_clean <- num_vars %>%
  mutate(across(everything(),
                ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .x)))

cat_vars <- pedon_features %>%
  select(dom_texture, dom_hue,
         taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.x) | .x == "", "unknown", .x)))

cat_mm <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = cat_vars)

umap_input <- cbind(num_vars_clean, cat_mm)

good_cols <- apply(umap_input, 2, function(x) is.finite(sd(x)) && sd(x) > 0)
umap_input2 <- umap_input[, good_cols, drop = FALSE]

umap_scaled <- scale(umap_input2)
stopifnot(all(is.finite(umap_scaled)))

set.seed(42)
umap_out <- umap(umap_scaled, n_neighbors = 15, min_dist = 0.1, metric = "euclidean")
beepr::beep("wilhelm")

umap_coords <- as.data.frame(umap_out$layout)
names(umap_coords) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")

umap_df <- bind_cols(
  pedon_features %>%
    transmute(
      peiidref, upedonid,
      series = pretty_title(series_clean),
      taxorder = pretty_title(taxorder),
      mean_sand, mean_clay, mean_cec7
    ),
  umap_coords
)

# plot by series (cleaned)
ggplot(umap_df, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = series)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2.0) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "UMAP of Coastal Plain NCSS Pedons (0–150 cm + depth-hot-encoding)",
       color = "Series")

# plot by sand
ggplot(umap_df, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = series)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2.0) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "UMAP colored by mean sand (0–150 cm)")


#end chunk
```
